title: Hs Android-friendly Termux packages
note: Curated optional packages. These are Termux packages built for Android/Bionic, not Debian .deb binaries. Install only when needed.

packages.name: android-tools
packages.note: ADB/Fastboot availability is limited by Android USB, permissions and device policy; this does not grant root.

packages.name: termux-api
packages.description: CLI commands for Android device APIs
packages.note: Requires the separate Termux:API Android app, installed from the same signing source as Termux.

packages.name: proot-distro
packages.description: Install and manage Debian and other PRoot distributions
packages.note: User-space Linux only; no real root, kernel modules or privileged mounts.

packages.name: termux-services
packages.note: Android may stop background processes; use battery and background execution settings where appropriate.

packages.name: 7zip
packages.note: Archive format support depends on the package build; encrypted and solid archives may be slower on mobile.

packages.name: fd
packages.note: Works within directories and permissions accessible to the Termux app.

packages.name: aria2
packages.note: Large downloads require available storage and a stable network.

packages.name: fish
packages.description: Interactive shell with autosuggestions and completions
packages.note: Optional shell; does not replace Bash unless the user changes their login shell.

packages.name: fzf
packages.description: Fuzzy finder for files, history and command output

packages.name: jq
packages.note: Useful for scripts and API responses.
